summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, coords) pairs with a Note in the docstring; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_length). Unverified: pytest has not been run, so pinned values and seeded shifts are unconfirmed; the test images were inferred as np.arange(16) reshaped to 1x4x4 from the pinned values. Black and flake8 were not run; a grep shows no new lines over 120 characters. Nothing is committed.
